clue.text: Agreed to adopt pet that's "difficult"

indicators.note: to adopt is to take in, so the word for agreed takes the pet inside it

parts.note: complied means agreed or went along with
a cat is a typical household pet

explanation.surface: Someone has agreed to take on an animal that is known to be a handful.
explanation.definitionFit: Something complicated is involved and hard to deal with, a near synonym of difficult.

clue.text: Source of vegan milk and butter's ignored at first

indicators.note: the opening letter is ignored, so the first letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a goat is a butter, an animal that butts, so butter's gives GOAT'S

explanation.surface: A dairy-free milk, with butter left out of the recipe from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butter' is not the spread but an animal that butts: the goat. Drop the G of GOATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Oat milk is a popular plant-based drink, so oats are a source of milk for vegans.

clue.text: Ring on the phone for cover?

indicators.note: heard over the phone the word comes across as sound only, signalling a soundalike

parts.note: a peal is a ringing of bells

explanation.surface: Asking whether giving someone a ring on the phone will provide an alibi.
explanation.definitionFit: Peel is the skin or rind that covers a fruit.

clue.text: Some slim men seem huge

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A paradox: thin men somehow look enormous.
explanation.definitionFit: Immense is a direct synonym of huge, both meaning extremely large.

clue.text: Sharp American hero

parts.note: El Cid was the Spanish national hero of legend

explanation.surface: Describing a keen-witted US champion.
explanation.walkthrough: El Cid is the medieval Castilian warrior celebrated as Spain's great hero.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid as an adjective means sharp or biting, of a taste or a remark.

clue.text: Polished English member pursued by worker

indicators.note: pursued by means followed by, so the worker comes after the rest

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
the ant is the crossword's classic worker

explanation.surface: A refined English politician being chased by a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Elegant manners or prose are graceful and refined, as is anything polished.

clue.text: Units in church books I encountered with reserve

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books
met means encountered

explanation.surface: Something measured within a church's books that I came upon with some restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: Centimetres are metric units of length, each a hundredth of a metre.

clue.text: No more stars out for those observing them

indicators.note: out here means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: When the stars stop shining, the people who watch them are out of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronomers are scientists who study celestial bodies, so they observe the stars.

clue.text: Succeeds in making contact with ghettos from time to time

indicators.note: occasionally, so only every other letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Someone manages to reach people in deprived urban districts now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: To get someone, as in getting them on the phone, is to reach or contact them.

clue.text: Watercourse given protective coating and made more efficient

parts.note: a stream is a small watercourse
lined means given an inner protective layer

explanation.surface: A channel is lined and so improved for flow.
explanation.definitionFit: Streamlined processes have been simplified so that they work better, an idiom from smooth aerodynamic shapes.

clue.text: Lead strike-breaker is sent back

indicators.note: sent back means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a rat is slang for a worker who breaks a strike

explanation.surface: The ringleader who crossed the picket line is dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: The star of a play or film plays the lead role.

clue.text: Dreadfully disables the securely settled

indicators.note: dreadfully means very badly, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Something terrible cripples people who were comfortably placed.
explanation.definitionFit: Established means firmly set up and settled, as an established business or custom.

clue.text: For Shakira, perhaps the concert is arranged using such equipment?

parts.note: Shakira is Colombian, a Spanish speaker, and the Spanish for the is el

indicators.note: arranged means put in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pop star's show is set up using all the amplifiers and gear on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakira stands for any Spanish speaker, giving the Spanish word for 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: Electronics covers circuits and devices, the kind of equipment used for a staged concert.

clue.text: Disregarding others, mostly trade in seafood

indicators.note: mostly means most of it, so the last letter is cut off

parts.note: to sell is to trade goods
fish is food from the sea

explanation.surface: A fishmonger cares little for others.
explanation.definitionFit: A selfish person thinks only of themselves and ignores other people's needs.

clue.text: Hospital with complaints — they are proverbially old

parts.note: H is the map and sign abbreviation for hospital
ills are ailments, complaints in the medical sense

explanation.surface: Old patients in a hospital with their ailments.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying 'as old as the hills' makes hills the proverbial image of great age.

clue.text: Rotund figure who will run when he's warmed up?

definitions.text: Rotund figure who will run when he's warmed up?

parts.words: Rotund figure who will run when he's warmed up?
parts.note: a round figure built in winter melts, or runs, once the weather warms

explanation.walkthrough: 'Run' suggests a jogger loosening up, but here it means melting like wax or water.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure made of packed snow is plump, and in sunshine it melts away.

clue.text: Explained method used between bridge partners

indicators.note: used between means placed in the middle, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: in bridge, South and North play as partners, giving S and N
how means the way or method something is done

explanation.surface: Describing a convention that two bridge players agree between themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: To have shown someone how something works is to have explained or demonstrated it.

clue.text: Boat destroyed according to report

indicators.note: a report is what is heard, so this signals a word that sounds the same

parts.note: ate can mean consumed or destroyed, as rust ate the metal

explanation.surface: A news story says a vessel was wrecked.
explanation.walkthrough: In rowing, an eight is a racing boat for eight oarsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: An eight is the rowing shell crewed by eight rowers plus a cox.

clue.text: Principal masonry construction

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a curved structure of stone or brick spanning an opening

explanation.surface: The main piece of stonework.
explanation.definitionFit: As a prefix or adjective it means chief; as a noun it is a curved span built of stones.

clue.text: Piece of news I came across in review

indicators.note: to review is to look back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: met means came across or encountered

explanation.surface: A journalist found a story while looking over the papers.
explanation.definitionFit: An item is a single report or article in a newspaper or bulletin.

clue.text: Large numbers in the US suddenly turn on south

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the letter for south follows

parts.note: to slew is to swing round or turn sharply
S is the compass abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: Crowds of Americans abruptly swing southward.
explanation.walkthrough: Slew in the sense of a great many is mainly American usage.
explanation.definitionFit: A slew is a large quantity, so slews are lots, an informal Americanism.

clue.text: Main team in coastal area

parts.note: the main is a poetic name for the open sea
a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: The principal team plays its games by the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: The seaside is the land beside the sea, a holiday coast.

clue.text: Star bishop, holder of tea for tanning

parts.note: the sun is our star
B is the chess notation for bishop
a tea urn holds hot tea for many cups

explanation.surface: A celebrity cleric with a tea urn lying out in the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunburn is skin reddening or browning from the sun, an overdone form of getting a tan.

clue.text: Stories about ordinary runs with cargo essentially in heavy vehicles

indicators.note: about means around, so the stories wrap round the other letters

parts.note: lies are untrue stories
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: essentially means at its heart, so the central letter is taken

parts.note: the middle letter of the word

explanation.surface: Tales of routine journeys carrying loads in trucks.
explanation.walkthrough: LIES goes around O, R and the R at the heart of 'cargo'; lorries is the British word for trucks.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorries are large goods trucks, the British name for heavy goods vehicles.

clue.text: Northern university to sort out type of weapon

parts.note: to clear up a problem is to sort it out

explanation.surface: A northern university tackling weapons issues.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuclear describes arms powered by atomic fission or fusion, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Confess last of moral offences, becoming good

indicators.note: last of points at the final letter of the word as the one to change
becoming means turning into, so one letter is swapped for another

parts.note: sins are moral wrongdoings

explanation.surface: A penitent admits wrongdoing and becomes virtuous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Confess' sounds religious, but sing is slang for informing to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: To sing, in criminal slang, is to tell all to the police, to own up.

clue.text: Performs things agreed on without pressure

indicators.note: without means lacking, so a letter is removed

parts.note: pacts are agreements
P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Someone honours their agreements freely, under no duress.
explanation.definitionFit: To act is to perform, on stage or in deed.

clue.text: Closely interwoven mass gathering for dancing

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a formal dance party

explanation.surface: A tightly packed crowd at a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A ball is both a wound-up sphere of string or wool and a grand social event with dancing.

clue.text: Swelter when cycling the area

indicators.note: cycling moves a letter round from the front to the back

explanation.surface: Someone gets very hot while biking round the district.
explanation.walkthrough: THEA becomes the answer when its first letter T is moved to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat as a noun is oppressive warmth, and swelter is the same stifling hot weather.

clue.text: Advised against new computer-aided design after clumsy pediment removed

indicators.note: new signals that the letters are formed into a fresh arrangement
clumsy signals that the second set of letters is jumbled, any order
removed says those jumbled letters are taken away from the first set

explanation.surface: An architect is warned off fresh CAD plans after a botched pediment.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters of PEDIMENT out of COMPUTER-AIDED DESIGN; the eleven left rearrange to the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To have discouraged someone is to have advised them not to do something, deterring them.

clue.text: Every single fruit that's not soft

indicators.note: that's not means lacking, so the letter is removed

parts.note: a peach is a fruit
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, soft

explanation.surface: Every piece of fruit is firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Each refers to every one taken separately, every individual item.

clue.text: Distinctive character of shifty oriental spy

indicators.note: shifty means moving about, so the letters are shifted around

explanation.surface: A suspicious eastern agent has a memorable manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Personality is the set of traits that make up an individual's nature.
